restaurantName: 144 On The Hill at Richmond Hill Hotel
bio: For a decadent delight, while away an afternoon with 144's sumptuous Afternoon Tea, inspired by their glorious hilltop surroundings. Indulge in an array of mouth-watering sandwiches on artisan bread, sweet scones and a delicate patisserie selection.  144 On The Hill are delighted to offer their Afternoon Tea in association with Whittard of Chelsea. Crafted from whole leaves, experience the best of teas in the most authentic way.  Afternoon Tea is served in their beautiful Georgian lounge, renowned for its timeless elegance and contemporary styling. Add some sparkle with a glass of prosecco, Champagne or a china pot of their very own signature infused blackberry gin.  Afternoon tea starts at £40 per person or £76 for two and is served 1.30pm-5pm daily. Traditional, savoury and vegan options available.
pageTitle: 144 On The Hill at Richmond Hill Hotel
